items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: he loves Duke Ellington, Monk, Coltrane, some of them

ctx.x: Was there a certain age, when you were a teenager or whenever, when you were really thinking — well let me rephrase the question. Was there a point where you thought I could really make a living being an entertainer?

No. I was sort of like in limbo. I sort of dropped into singing. As I said, my sister-in-law sent me to a coach to get an act, AK, at a very good piano player and old football player. Let me think of his name. He had a booking agency on 125th Street. He sent me out to my © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
first professional job by an agent. He was a former football player. I’m sorry, Monk, it will come to me. Fritz Pollard.
